name: Lockatoo
description1: While its metallic cage provides perfect protection for its gentle body, it also leads to isolation. It will only reach outside of the bars to touch those with whom it shares an unbreakable bond.

name: Phurbash
description1: It can cleanse negative energy by driving its tip into the ground. However, its three faces constantly argue over where to plant itself.

name: Phurbanish
description1: Phurbanish will stop at nothing to cleanse negative energy from the earth. It will pierce its blade into anything with slightest hint of malice.
